ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central regions contrasted against low-intensity black trailing edges and mottled spots; ratio estimated at approximately 2.5:1 white-to-black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones occupying the center of both lobes. A thick, irregular black band extends along the entire trailing edge. A prominent black geometric blob is located on the upper medial section of the left lobe. Multiple discrete, low-intensity focal spots (mottling) are distributed across the distal third of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across both lobes; amplitude of peaks varies between 3 to 12 pixels relative to the local mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve terminating in acute distal tips; leading edge follows a standard convex arc partially obscured by water turbulence at the peduncle junction.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, circular low-intensity clusters (rosettes) distributed primarily on the white distal surfaces of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the right lobe exhibits extreme jaggedness and irregular pixel clusters, suggesting significant previous scarring or remnant barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetric large black pigmentation patch on the proximal interior margin of the left lobe, extending toward the notch.
